shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile low relief on a pillar face
animal shown with legs bent/crouching, tail extended
incised line/band crossing the pillar surface
relief carving on a flat rectangular monolith face
justification: Both show shallow, schematic relief animals in strict profile with bent limbs and extended tails, carved on a flat pillar face and combined with incised linear bands, a fairly specific shared convention of rendering. However, A shows a single isolated quadruped above a broad curving line, while B stacks a dense multi-register program of repeated animals, birds, arcaded figures and a fringed band, so the composition and relational density differ greatly.
